meta.title: DSH TaskBridge
meta.description: Let Codex and Antigravity plan and review while DSH executes code inside a clean black-box MCP bridge: centralized API/model/effort routing, Git worktree isolation & cross-subtask reuse, one-click setup, quiet waiting, scoped approvals and linked cleanup (cutting strong-model non-cached tokens by 24.5%–32.1% at parity capability).
